messages:
mia_sales: FYI - FinRegBank POC (EU on‑prem/VPC) is blocked: when they pin model to `redwood/gpt-large-v2` they get a model-not-found error. They need a workaround to run a short suite of compliance prompts today. Account: FRB-3456. Any quick path?

devon_eng: can you paste the exact error from their logs? sounds like a model-version availability/replication issue.

mia_sales: pasted below from customer logs: 
```
ERROR 503 model_not_available: model 'redwood/gpt-large-v2' not available in region eu-west-1
request_id=6a1f4c
```

finreg_bot: also seeing intermittent 429s before the 503s when they ramp traffic from our test client (50 rps).

ops_bot: alert: 429 spike detected in dedicated test pool eu-west-1 between 12:03-12:07 UTC. median latency 220ms, token cost same.

anika_infra: quick summary: v2 was deprecated in eu-west for the on‑prem replication job last week while we were rolling a quantized mirror. eu-west hasn't yet fully mirrored the fallback artifact. So pinned requests fail instead of routing to a compatible variant.

sam_se: customer asks two things: (1) immediate workaround to continue tests, (2) cost delta if we route them to quantized variant.

devon_eng: short term options: 1) change pin to `redwood/gpt-large-v1` (if they can accept older weights) 2) add a per-request fallback header to let router use compatible variant: `X-Model-Fallback: redwood/gpt-large-quantized-v2` 3) temporarily flip region routing to use eu-central replica (if allowed by their VPC peering).

mia_sales: which is the fastest to implement without infra changes?

anika_infra: header-based fallback is the fastest — no infra deploy, just router respects the header. Sample curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/infer \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Model-Fallback: redwood/gpt-large-quantized-v2" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-large-v2","input":"<prompt>"}'
```
This will let the request try v2 then fall back to quantized-v2; behavior is atomic — either returns model output or a single error.

devon_eng: reproduction steps I ran locally: sent 100 requests with that header and got only 2 fallbacks, no 503s. Without header ~30% 503. So header helps.

sam_se: pricing note: quantized variant is approx 0.45x per-token cost vs original float model. I'll attach a short compare in the followup email.

mia_sales: customer also asked about SLA / dedicated trial to avoid cross‑region fallback. Can we offer a temporary dedicated pool in eu-west?

anika_infra: we can spin a small dedicated pool for a week (2 GPUs) — requires CSM approval and a reserved quota bump. Lead time ~ 2 business days unless we use pre-provisioned capacity.

devon_eng: ops observed the 429s during their ramp. If we give them dedicated pool, ask them to use burst policy: `burst_tokens=2000` and keep sustained rps under 30 to avoid throttles while we mirror model.

mia_sales: action items: 
- sam_se: send cost delta + one‑week dedicated trial quote to FRB-3456 (ETA: 3h)
- anika_infra: attempt on‑the‑fly enable of fallback header behavior for their tenant (ETA: 4h)
- devon_eng: provide a small repro script and recommended client retry/backoff to attach to the FRB test harness
- mia_sales: schedule hangout at 16:00 UTC to validate once the header/quote are in place

sam_se: ACK — will include discounted trial pricing and note that quantized throughput is slightly faster.

anika_infra: I'll also open a short infra ticket to prioritize mirroring `gpt-large-quantized-v2` into eu-west; internal ticket #INF-8921. If mirroring completes we can remove header fallback.

devon_eng: repro script (js): 
```
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
async function test(){
  for(let i=0;i<100;i++){
    await fetch('https://api.redwood/infer',{method:'POST',headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer $T','Content-Type':'application/json','X-Model-Fallback':'redwood/gpt-large-quantized-v2'},body:JSON.stringify({model:'redwood/gpt-large-v2',input:'test'})});
  }
}
```

mia_sales: thanks all — I'll update FRB and run the 16:00 check. Please drop short confirmations in thread when PRICING/HEADER/TICKET are available. :thumbsup:

ops_bot: note: I'll mute the 429 alert for FRB-3456 once dedicated pool is active to avoid noisy paging.

sam_se: price sheet attached in email; ping me if they want a 30% pilot discount.

anika_infra: header routing enabled for tenant FRB-3456 (rolled at 14:41 UTC). Please verify.

devon_eng: verified from our end — header fallback working, customer tests show no 503 now, 429 only when exceeding sustained rps.

mia_sales: Verified with customer on call at 16:10 — all green. Moving to post‑POC follow up for dedicated trial. Closing for now. :white_check_mark:
